parts.text: A factory releases some dirt into the river. The dirt moves parallel to the river bed at the same speed as the water. At the same instant that the factory releases the dirt, the engineer lowers a metal grid into the river. The metal grid is 20 m from the factory. The metal grid does not affect the speed of the water but will stop the dirt.

content.tex: A factory releases some dirt into the river. The dirt moves parallel to the river bed at the same speed as the water.
At the same instant that the factory releases the dirt, the engineer lowers a metal grid into the river. The metal grid is \(20m\) from the factory.
The metal grid does not affect the speed of the water but will stop the dirt.
